name: Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Ltd
title: Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Ltd - 544453 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Order book ~INR615-750 cr and FY26 revenue +11.4% to INR171.7 cr, but H2 revenue fell to INR99.8 cr from INR115.9 cr, with receivables ~INR55 cr and no quantified guidance.

capex.quote: we are investing in advanced equipment, particularly focusing on GEDO, digital twin market, LiDARs, drone surveying

triggers.label: Receivables ~INR55 cr; operating cash flow negative

triggers.label: Headcount 630 to ~740 with revenue lagging

guidance.value: maintain past performance, give or take some basis points
